comparison_contract.phase3: Saved Phase01 RFT and available corrected DasAtom schedules, retimed/scored only; compile times reused explicitly
comparison_contract.phase4: 66 matched RFT targets; fresh unmodified control plus h1/2/4/8; DasAtom stays the Phase03-scored anchor
comparison_contract.geometry: Same declared analytical two-plane geometry for every control/variant; no calibrated native physical claim
comparison_contract.model: extended_no_cooling.v1; cubic timing/heating, per-atom transfers and common exposure
comparison_contract.quality_scope: normalized CZ skeleton; no cooling without extra hardware
comparison_contract.timing: Original benchmark_runner.run_benchmark region, including event index/parking; frozen module setup and scoring excluded
comparison_contract.warmup: One unchanged reference warmup; modified warmup then restore unchanged measured-start global RNG
comparison_contract.diagnostics: Bounded eight snapshots; same production FutureEventIndex and FuturePotential APIs
comparison_contract.workers: one serial owned family, observed 4GiB cap, finite wall cap
comparison_contract.execution: New comparisons serialize with each other and wait while the Phase01 controller lock is held
comparison_contract.failures: Keep invalid/unsupported/timeouts/errors; do not retry unchanged terminal failures; resume missing source schedules
